stops.note: named the supernatural spirit beings central to Hopi religious life
stops.meaning: a spirit being that links gods and mortals

stops.note: anglicized by ethnographers and later popularized through carved kachina dolls sold to collectors
stops.meaning: a spirit figure in Hopi and Pueblo religion, or a carved doll representing one

current_meaning: in Hopi and other Pueblo traditions, a spirit being, or a carved wooden doll representing one
